# Megability

> An AI Parent Navigator and intelligent automated system for Ontario pediatric, speech, occupational therapy, and autism clinics.

## Core Product

- **Sunny by Megability**: A specialized AI assistant that helps special-needs healthcare clinics automate intake, front-desk workflows, and waitlist fatigue.
- **Key Functionality**: Instantly navigates complex Ontario funding rules (OAP, SSAH, ACSD) to assist clinic staff and client families in real time.

## Target Audience & Niche

- **Primary Market**: B2B Pediatric Therapy Clinics, Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs), Occupational Therapists (OTs), and Autism Service Providers.
- **Geographic Area Served**: Ontario, Canada.

## Essential Marketing URLs

- [Homepage](https://www.megability.ca/) - Overview of the Megability and Sunny platform.
- [Pricing](https://www.megability.ca/pricing) - SaaS tiers and platform access options.
